description: G. E. Street's Victorian Gothic law courts (1873–82): the pointed entrance arch between two spired turrets under the Great Hall's gable and flèche, the Bell Yard clock tower, and a skyline of steep slate roofs, gables, turrets and spirelets in pale Portland stone and banded brick.
